extension_name.message: ReadFollow: Text to Speech with Word Highlights

extension_description.message: Reads text aloud and highlights each word on the page as it is spoken. Works on web pages and PDFs, offline or with online voices.

options_enable_piper_voices.message: Download natural voices that run on your device (Piper)...

options_rate_warning.message: Note: some voices may not work at a high speed.

advanced_word_replacements_placeholder.message:
One per line, in the form “word = replacement”, case insensitive. Leave the replacement empty to skip the word.

GIF = jif
e.g. = for example
[citation needed] =

advanced_word_replacements_error_duplica.message: Line $LINE$: “$WORD$” is already replaced on line $FIRST_LINE$

player_tab_explanation.message: ReadFollow uses this tab for audio playback. This tab will automatically close after 5 minutes of no activity.

player_hidethistab_dialog_body.message:
If you hide this tab, ReadFollow will play audio inside the current webpage. This means navigating away from the page will cause the speech to stop.

(You can change this back in ReadFollow's settings.)

error_no_text.message: Didn't find any text to read, try selecting the text you want to read first

error_upload_pdf.message: Open your PDF file in this viewer to read it aloud: Tools (the >> button at the top right), then Open, or drag the file onto the page

error_ajax_pdf.message: Please save this PDF file to your computer and open it inside this [PDF viewer](open-pdf-viewer) to read aloud

error_file_access.message: You need to grant ReadFollow access to file URLs in extension [settings](open-extension-settings)

error_add_permissions.message: You need to grant ReadFollow additional [permissions](request-permissions) for this website

error_chatgpt.message: Click the speaker icon next to each answer to read it aloud

google_translate_request_permission.message: ReadFollow would like to use Google Translate for text-to-speech.

google_translate_keep_page_open.message: ReadFollow is using Google Translate for text-to-speech.  Please keep this tab open.

advanced_bt_silence_gap.message: Fix missing first few words of each paragraph when using a Bluetooth headset

languages_explanation.message: Pick the languages you read. Only their voices are listed in the voice menu. Choose a voice under a language to always use it for that language.

custom_voices_explanation.message: Add your own account with a cloud voice provider to use its voices. Your keys are stored in this browser only. Text you read with these voices is sent to that provider.

welcome_heading.message: ReadFollow reads text aloud and highlights each word on the page as it is spoken.

welcome_sample.message: This paragraph is read with your default voice. The sentence being read turns blue, and the current word is marked in amber and underlined, so you can follow along with your eyes.

welcome_start_select.message: Select text on any page and press Alt+O. A small bar appears at the bottom of the page with pause, skip, speed and stop.

welcome_start_menu.message: Right-click selected text and choose "Read aloud selected text".

welcome_start_button.message: Click the ReadFollow button in the toolbar to read the whole page.

welcome_pin_chrome.message: Don't see the button? Click the puzzle piece next to the address bar, then the pin next to ReadFollow.

welcome_pin_firefox.message: Don't see the button? Click the extensions button (the puzzle piece) in the toolbar, then the gear next to ReadFollow and "Pin to Toolbar".

welcome_shortcuts_missing.message: Some shortcuts could not be set, usually because another extension already uses the same keys. You can choose different keys below.

welcome_privacy_body.message: With the voices built into your computer and the downloadable Piper voices, text never leaves your device. Google Translate and the cloud voices you add yourself (OpenAI, Azure, Amazon Polly, IBM) receive the text you ask them to read, and nothing else. ReadFollow has no account and collects no data. Error reports are optional and off by default.

options_bar_shown_everywhere.message: Shown on every site. To hide it on one site, use the menu at the end of the bar.

voice_privacy_auto.message: Auto select uses a voice on this device when one matches the language. When none does, it may use an online Google voice, which receives the text you read.

voice_privacy_remote.message: Text you read with this voice is sent to $1.

voice_privacy_local.message: This voice runs on your device. Text stays on it.

about_support_body.message: ReadFollow is free, with no account and no ads, and it will stay that way. If it helps you read, you can support its development.

about_credit_read_aloud.message: ReadFollow started as a fork of Read Aloud, which still provides the page reading and most of the voices.

about_credit_piper.message: The natural voices that run on your device.

about_credit_onnx.message: Runs the Piper voice models in the browser.

about_credit_espeak.message: Turns text into speech sounds for the Piper voices. It runs as a separate program.

about_not_affiliated.message: ReadFollow is not affiliated with or endorsed by Read Aloud or its author.

welcome_footer.message: ReadFollow is free and open source, built on Read Aloud by Hai Phan.

about_more_window_fullscreen.message: Makes the YouTube player fill your browser window without going fullscreen, so your tabs, address bar and taskbar stay where they are. Free and open source, by the same developer.

release_notes_full_changelog.message: Every change, including the ones you won't notice

options_error_reports_help.message: When reading fails, tell the developer what went wrong. Never includes the text you read or the page.
